hla.rti

Interface SuppliedAttributes


  • public interface SuppliedAttributes
    This packages the attributes supplied to the RTI for updateAttributeValues. This is conceptually an array with an initial capacity and the ability to grow. You enumerate by stepping index from 0 to size()-1.
